name: Asahi Aino
source:
Aino goes to the same school as [url=/c174492]Mitsuki[/url], [url=/c174567]Haru[/url] and [url=/c174649]Daisuke[/url], but a year older. 

He is the epitome of a perfect senpai, always ready to help and support. He is very popular due to his good looks and kind personality. 

Aino could be called a perfect guy. He is handsome, intelligent, kind, and can hold a conversation on different topics. Aino, however, considers himself indecisive and clumsy. 

He became fascinated with magic tricks after visiting a circus. After getting lost, one of the magicians distracted the boy until his parents arrived. At the time, magic tricks seemed like real magic to Aino.

[i]"It's about skill, not luck. I don't want to be just another part of the gray mass".[/i]

[Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753200]official art-book[/url]]
